items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I've heard of him, I never knew him.

ctx.x: With Chris's band then? Was he the leader?

Yeah, he'd be the leader but we'd pick up men, you see. Pick up anybody? Anybody. That's how I would. He'd pick up like the guy well known if he'd get killed or die. Well, they had fellas going around, one by the name, Ernest, French, Taki, or Jerry. Well, they'd go around and pick up. What's the name of they'd pick up? He'd carry to Chris and we'd play a few.
Yeah. Those guys would be like agents for Chris, would they? Picking up the work?
